title: Agent Memory Public API: Recall Context Envelope
description: The public, versioned form of a recall context (Sprint 4a, contract 1.0.0). principal_ref is caller-asserted; the embedding host authenticates recall principals (#364). Contract 1.4.0 (#670) adds an optional budget: a return policy applied to the ranked admitted prefix after admission and after ranking, never authority.

budget.description: Return budget (contract 1.4.0, #670): at most k of the ranked admitted facts are returned in `returned`; `admitted` always carries the full ranked admitted set.
